_doc: Deterministic agent-dispatch oracle (#1267). Declares the required agent/vertical set for each (tier x track x pr_type), INDEPENDENTLY of the selection code, so scripts/check-agent-dispatch.mjs can replay the actual derivation and assert no drift. Stored compressed: a per-tier base + additive track/pr_type modifiers. Resolution is UNION-only (additive; never narrows below the tier floor) — fail-safe toward MORE review. This file is the SSOT for the tier->vertical floor: scripts/route-auditors.mjs reads `tier_verticals` here (replacing its old inlined SIZE_FLOOR_VERTICALS) and src/commands/task-ship.ts::verticalsForTier is asserted equal to it by the gate. (#1817 — the review_pass_count axis was removed with the multi-pass review dispatch subsystem.)

refutation_skeptics._doc: M13 refutation-by-majority fan-out (#1943). N independent skeptics per acted-on finding above the severity threshold. Declared here (the dispatch SSOT) so the refutation skill's documented N table (scripts/check-agent-dispatch.mjs parity assertion) cannot drift from the dispatch oracle. Solo XS/S = 1 (the red-team IS the skeptic); Standard = 3; gated-review raises to the full vertical set (tier_verticals.Standard).
